Yes — that feels natural. I clicked into the title and the description right there on the "here's what we found" screen and just typed over them, which is exactly what I wanted. If a page's own title is too long or worded oddly, I can fix it to how I'll actually remember it before it lands in my library.

And the division feels right to me. The icon and the preview picture are the fiddly bits I'd never want to set by hand, so I'm happy those stay automatic. The title and description are the words *I* think in, so those are the ones I want control over. Good split.
